exercises.name: Warm-up
steps: Stand with arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles, then slowly bigger ones.
Switch direction halfway.
exercises.tip: Keep your shoulders down and relaxed.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squats
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart, arms out in front.
Push hips back and bend knees, like sitting on a chair.
Go down until thighs are level, then stand up through your heels.
exercises.tip: Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Push-ups (knee ok)
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Push back up. Too hard? Put your knees down.
exercises.tip: Don't let your hips sag — squeeze your belly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell / bottle rows
steps: Hold a dumbbell or water bottle and bend forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and let the arm hang down.
Pull your elbow up to your ribs, then lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Move the elbow, not the shoulder — no jerking.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips up.
Hold 1 second at the top, then lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Push through your heels, not your toes.

exercises.name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Lift your body so head to heels is one straight line.
Hold and breathe slowly for the full time.
exercises.tip: Hips level — not up in the air, not sagging.

exercises.name: Cool-down walk
steps: Stand tall, look ahead, shoulders relaxed.
Swing your arms naturally with each step.
Walk fast enough that talking feels a little hard.
exercises.tip: A short walk after every meal is a great habit.

exercises.name: Brisk walk
steps: Stand tall, look ahead, shoulders relaxed.
Swing your arms naturally with each step.
Walk fast enough that talking feels a little hard.
exercises.tip: A short walk after every meal is a great habit.

exercises.name: Stretching
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than hips.
Reach both arms up, then slowly bend to one side.
Hold 15–20 seconds each side and breathe deeply.
exercises.tip: Stretch gently — never bounce or force it.

exercises.name: Warm-up
steps: Start standing, feet together, arms down.
Jump feet out while raising arms overhead.
Jump back to the start. Keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.tip: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Push-ups
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Push back up. Too hard? Put your knees down.
exercises.tip: Don't let your hips sag — squeeze your belly.

exercises.name: Shoulder press (dumbbell / bottles)
steps: Hold weights (or bottles) at shoulder height, elbows out.
Push them straight up overhead.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
exercises.tip: Tighten your belly — don't lean back.

exercises.name: Bicep curls
steps: Stand tall with weights in your hands, palms forward.
Bend your elbows and lift the weights to your shoulders.
Lower slowly all the way down.
exercises.tip: Keep elbows close to your sides — no swinging.

exercises.name: Chair dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair, hands beside your hips.
Slide forward and lower your body by bending your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Use a chair that won't slide, keep your back close to it.

exercises.name: Crunches
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor using your belly.
Lower slowly. Don't pull on your neck.
exercises.tip: Look at the ceiling — keep a fist of space under your chin.

exercises.name: Side plank
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body makes a straight line.
Hold, then switch to the other side.
exercises.tip: Too hard? Drop the bottom knee to the floor.

exercises.tip: A short walk after every meal is a great habit.

exercises.name: Intervals
steps: Warm up first with an easy walk.
Go fast for 30 seconds — jog or high knees.
Walk slowly for 90 seconds to recover, then repeat.
exercises.tip: Push hard on the fast part, relax fully on the slow part.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
steps: Start in a push-up position, arms straight.
Drive one knee towards your chest.
Switch legs quickly, like running in place.
exercises.tip: Keep your hips low and hands under your shoulders.

exercises.name: Cool-down + stretch
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than hips.
Reach both arms up, then slowly bend to one side.
Hold 15–20 seconds each side and breathe deeply.
exercises.tip: Stretch gently — never bounce or force it.

exercises.name: Lunges
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward and lower until both knees bend.
Push back up to standing, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Front knee stays above the ankle, not past the toes.

exercises.name: Step-ups (stairs / chair)
steps: Stand facing a stair or a sturdy low step.
Step up with one foot and push through that heel.
Bring the other foot up, then step down slowly.
exercises.tip: Hold a rail or wall for balance if you need it.

exercises.name: Calf raises
steps: Stand tall, hold a wall for balance.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.
exercises.tip: Going down slowly works the muscle best.

exercises.name: Leg raises
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands by your sides.
Lift both legs up slowly, keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
exercises.tip: Press your lower back into the floor the whole time.

steps: Stand on one leg, put the other foot on your inner calf or thigh.
Hands together at your chest and find your balance.
Raise your arms overhead and breathe slowly.
exercises.tip: Look at one fixed point to keep your balance.

exercises.name: Weigh yourself
exercises.reps: Morning, empty stomach — log it in Me
steps: Weigh in the morning after the toilet, before eating.
Same scale, same place, light clothes.
Write the number in the Me tab.
exercises.tip: Weight goes up and down daily — watch the weekly trend.
